name: vanity
description: a wooden vanity with a cracked, spotted mirror. a silver hairbrush and jewelry box sit on it, exactly as they were left. the mirror reflects strangely — your image seems to move a split second after you do.

params.success_message: you stare at your reflection in the cracked mirror. for just a moment, the reflection isn't you. a woman in a dark victorian dress stares back, her hand pressed against the glass from the other side. then your own reflection returns.
